reuse_findings.outbound_group_dedup: QQOutboundGuardService admits then records, so ambiguous send failure fails toward less repeated output
reuse_findings.group_mute_and_burst: GroupSendSafety performs final mute/rate admission and keeps failed/uncertain attempt reservations
reuse_findings.proactive_private: shared ProactiveBudget consumes ambiguous sending attempts; QQProactiveInitiativeService enforces quiet hours, daily budget, gap and recent-admin-activity grace
reuse_findings.reconnect: pinned OneBot forward connector already auto-redials after disconnect with bounded backoff; plugin startup intentionally does not wait for OneBot because transport self-heals

machine_gate.rationale: Promote external surface semantics into executable XiaoYu release acceptance without vendoring or duplicating the QQ runtime.

verification.note: The gate was added after the local operator tunnel disconnected. No claim is made that this new expanded regression slice has already executed locally.
